EmailTemplate.subject: Announcing New Expanded B2B Payments Offerings
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Businesses today spend too much time and money cobbling together homegrown solutions or relying on disparate, legacy payment systems, diverting meaningful resources away from revenue-generating work.
Flywire has tailor-made software to focus on key problems in organizations’ A/R workflows and handle all the complexities associated with global payment infrastructure. Now, companies do not need to build payment solutions or develop in-house expertise - they are freed up to focus on results.
“I highly recommend Flywire! Flywire as a platform is very easy to use. It's transparent and incredibly user friendly. Also, the Flywire team is very supportive and responsive. Most importantly, we’re saving money and improving our customer experience <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/case-study-appsflyer?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>.” - Moshe Grimberg, CFO, AppsFlyer
Leveraging the breadth and power of our global payment network and integrated software, as well as our experience processing payments for more than 2,000 clients in 240 countries and territories around the world, Flywire’s B2B solutions enhance existing banking and treasury functions and eliminate many of the operational challenges related to international payments.
Learn more about our expanded B2B offerings <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/flywire-expands-b2b-business?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>, or reply to this email to set up a time to talk through how Flywire can help you save your business cash and effort.
